```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(data.table)
count_fmt <- function(x) format(x, big.mark = ",", scientific = FALSE, trim = TRUE)
```

## Study scope

The dataset covers September through December in 2023 and 2024 and September
through November in 2025. We kept flights reported by WN, AA, DL, and UA,
excluded flights marked as diverted, and ranked origin cities by the remaining
record count across all four airlines and 11 months. We kept every destination
served by flights departing from the ten highest-ranked cities. The filtered
records and all original fields are saved in `flights_scoped.csv`.

```{r scoping, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE}
files <- c(
  "airlines_2023_9.csv",  "airlines_2023_10.csv",
  "airlines_2023_11.csv", "airlines_2023_12.csv",
  "airlines_2024_9.csv",  "airlines_2024_10.csv",
  "airlines_2024_11.csv", "airlines_2024_12.csv",
  "airlines_2025_9.csv",  "airlines_2025_10.csv",
  "airlines_2025_11.csv"
)

months <- sub("^airlines_(.*)\\.csv$", "\\1", files)

files <- file.path("stat628_airplanes", files)

missing_files <- files[!file.exists(files)]
if (length(missing_files)) {
  stop("Missing files: ", paste(missing_files, collapse = ", "))
}

airlines <- c("WN", "AA", "DL", "UA")
in_scope <- function(x) {
  x$Reporting_Airline %chin% airlines & (is.na(x$Diverted) | x$Diverted != 1L)
}

scope_cols <- c("Reporting_Airline", "Diverted", "OriginCityName")
monthly_counts <- lapply(files, function(path) {
  x <- fread(path, select = scope_cols)
  x[in_scope(x) & !is.na(OriginCityName) & OriginCityName != "",
    .(Records = .N), by = OriginCityName]
})
city_counts <- rbindlist(monthly_counts)[
  , .(Records = sum(Records)), by = OriginCityName
]
setorder(city_counts, -Records, OriginCityName)
stopifnot(nrow(city_counts) >= 10L)
top_cities <- head(city_counts, 10)

# Process one month at a time so only one full input file is held in memory.
local_time_cols <- c("FlightDate", "CRSDepTime", "CRSArrTime",
                     "DepTime", "ArrTime", "WheelsOff", "WheelsOn")
scoped_file <- "flights_scoped.csv"
temp_file <- tempfile(pattern = "flights_scoped_", tmpdir = dirname(scoped_file))
rows_written <- 0L

for (i in seq_along(files)) {
  x <- fread(files[i], colClasses = list(character = local_time_cols))
  selected <- x[in_scope(x) & OriginCityName %chin% top_cities$OriginCityName]
  rows_written <- rows_written + nrow(selected)
  fwrite(selected, temp_file, append = i > 1L, col.names = i == 1L, na = "")
}
stopifnot(rows_written == sum(top_cities$Records), file.rename(temp_file, scoped_file))
rm(x, selected)

knitr::kable(top_cities[, .(`Origin city` = OriginCityName, Records = count_fmt(Records))],
             align = "lr", caption = "Selected origin cities and flight record counts.")
```

## Cleaning and time conversion

```{r validate-and-join, include=FALSE}
flights <- fread(scoped_file, colClasses = list(character = local_time_cols))
flights <- unique(flights)
rows_after_dedup <- nrow(flights)
flight_key <- c(
  "FlightDate", "Reporting_Airline", "Flight_Number_Reporting_Airline",
  "OriginAirportID", "DestAirportID", "CRSDepTime"
)
repeated_keys <- flights[, .N, by = flight_key][N > 1L]

valid_hhmm <- function(x) {
  value <- suppressWarnings(as.integer(x))
  !is.na(value) & grepl("^[0-9]{1,4}$", x) &
    (value == 2400L | (value %/% 100L < 24L & value %% 100L < 60L))
}

expected_date <- with(flights, sprintf("%04d-%02d-%02d", Year, Month, DayofMonth))
expected_month <- with(flights, sprintf("%04d_%d", Year, Month))
valid_date <- !is.na(as.IDate(flights$FlightDate, format = "%Y-%m-%d")) &
  flights$FlightDate == expected_date & expected_month %chin% months

invalid_rows <- flights[
  which(!(valid_date %in% TRUE) |
          !(Reporting_Airline %chin% airlines) |
          !grepl("^[A-Z0-9]{3}$", Origin) | !grepl("^[A-Z0-9]{3}$", Dest) |
          !valid_hhmm(CRSDepTime) | !valid_hhmm(CRSArrTime)), .N
]

airport_codes <- unique(c(flights$Origin, flights$Dest))
tz_lookup <- unique(fread("stat628_airplanes/airports_timezone.csv")[
  iata_code %chin% airport_codes & iana_tz %chin% OlsonNames(), .(iata_code, iana_tz)
])
elev_lookup <- unique(fread("stat628_airplanes/airports_elevation.csv")[
  iata_code %chin% airport_codes & !is.na(elevation_ft), .(iata_code, elevation_ft)
])
stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(tz_lookup$iata_code), !anyDuplicated(elev_lookup$iata_code))

flights[, `:=`(
  origin_tz = tz_lookup$iana_tz[match(Origin, tz_lookup$iata_code)],
  dest_tz = tz_lookup$iana_tz[match(Dest, tz_lookup$iata_code)],
  origin_elevation_ft = elev_lookup$elevation_ft[match(Origin, elev_lookup$iata_code)],
  dest_elevation_ft = elev_lookup$elevation_ft[match(Dest, elev_lookup$iata_code)]
)]
missing_airports <- length(setdiff(airport_codes, intersect(
  tz_lookup$iata_code, elev_lookup$iata_code
)))
```

We dropped `r count_fmt(rows_written - rows_after_dedup)` exact duplicate rows.
After that check, `r count_fmt(nrow(repeated_keys))` flight identifiers appeared
more than once and `r count_fmt(invalid_rows)` records failed the airline,
airport-code, date, or scheduled-time checks. We matched the origin and
destination airports to their local time zones and elevations in feet.
Of the `r count_fmt(length(airport_codes))` airports, `r count_fmt(missing_airports)`
were missing a time zone or elevation.

Departure and arrival times are reported in each airport's local time. We
converted the four scheduled and actual times to UTC. We used the scheduled
flight duration to identify the arrival date and to check which departure time
fits when the same local hour occurs twice at the end of daylight saving time.
We obtained actual times by adding the reported delay in minutes to the
scheduled time and checked them against the recorded local times. A time
reported as 2400 represents midnight at the end of the associated local day.

```{r utc, include=FALSE}
as_utc <- function(x) {
  as.POSIXct(x, origin = "1970-01-01", tz = "UTC")
}

hhmm_normal <- function(x) {
  out <- rep(NA_character_, length(x))
  ok <- valid_hhmm(x)
  out[ok] <- sprintf("%04d", as.integer(x[ok]) %% 2400L)
  out
}

departure_candidates <- function(date, hhmm, zone, repeated) {
  wall <- as_utc(as.numeric(date) * 86400)
  value <- suppressWarnings(as.integer(hhmm))
  value[!valid_hhmm(hhmm)] <- NA_integer_

  # 2400 adds 24 hours and lands on midnight of the next local day.
  wall <- wall + (value %/% 100L * 60L + value %% 100L) * 60

  as_utc(as.numeric(lubridate::force_tz(
    wall, tzone = zone, roll_dst = c("NA", repeated)
  )))
}

flights[, c("sched_dep_utc", "sched_dep_late") := .(
  departure_candidates(as.IDate(FlightDate), CRSDepTime, origin_tz[1L], "pre"),
  departure_candidates(as.IDate(FlightDate), CRSDepTime, origin_tz[1L], "post")
), by = origin_tz]

flights[, c("early_ok", "late_ok") := {
  arrival_clock <- hhmm_normal(CRSArrTime)
  elapsed_seconds <- CRSElapsedTime * 60

  .(
    (format(sched_dep_utc + elapsed_seconds, "%H%M", tz = dest_tz[1L]) ==
       arrival_clock) %in% TRUE,
    (format(sched_dep_late + elapsed_seconds, "%H%M", tz = dest_tz[1L]) ==
       arrival_clock) %in% TRUE
  )
}, by = dest_tz]

# If a repeated local hour cannot be resolved, leave its UTC value missing.
flights[
  sched_dep_utc != sched_dep_late & early_ok == late_ok,
  sched_dep_utc := as_utc(NA_real_)
]
flights[!early_ok & late_ok, sched_dep_utc := sched_dep_late]

flights[, sched_arr_utc := sched_dep_utc + CRSElapsedTime * 60]
flights[!early_ok & !late_ok, sched_arr_utc := as_utc(NA_real_)]
flights[, sched_arr_verified := !is.na(sched_arr_utc)]
flights[, c("sched_dep_late", "early_ok", "late_ok") := NULL]

check_actual <- function(candidate, raw_clock, zone) {
  fcase(
    is.na(raw_clock) | raw_clock == "", "not_recorded",
    is.na(candidate) | !valid_hhmm(raw_clock), "unverified",
    format(candidate, "%H%M", tz = zone) == hhmm_normal(raw_clock), "verified",
    default = "conflict"
  )
}

flights[, `:=`(
  actual_dep_utc = sched_dep_utc + DepDelay * 60,
  actual_arr_utc = sched_arr_utc + ArrDelay * 60
)]

flights[, actual_dep_status := check_actual(
  actual_dep_utc, DepTime, origin_tz[1L]
), by = origin_tz]

flights[, actual_arr_status := check_actual(
  actual_arr_utc, ArrTime, dest_tz[1L]
), by = dest_tz]

flights[actual_dep_status != "verified", actual_dep_utc := as_utc(NA_real_)]
flights[actual_arr_status != "verified", actual_arr_utc := as_utc(NA_real_)]
```

For `r count_fmt(sum(!flights$sched_arr_verified))` flights, the scheduled
arrival clock time and the reported scheduled duration did not agree.
We left the derived arrival time blank for these flights and kept the original
record. We also kept cancelled flights and negative delay values, which
represent early departures or arrivals. A blank actual UTC time can reflect
an unrecorded time or a time that could not be verified. The status columns
identify the reason.

## Analysis file

We assigned data splits using the original flight month. September through
November 2023 and 2024 form the training set. December 2023 and 2024 form the
validation set. September through November 2025 form the test set.

```{r export, echo=FALSE}
flights[, split := fcase(
  Year == 2025L & Month %in% 9:11, "test",
  Year %in% c(2023L, 2024L) & Month == 12L, "validation",
  Year %in% c(2023L, 2024L) & Month %in% 9:11, "train",
  default = NA_character_
)]
stopifnot(nrow(flights) == rows_after_dedup, !anyNA(flights$split))
fwrite(flights, "flights_cleaned.csv", na = "", dateTimeAs = "ISO")

split_counts <- flights[, .(
  `Flight records` = count_fmt(.N),
  `Cancelled flights` = count_fmt(sum(Cancelled == 1L, na.rm = TRUE))
), by = .(Split = split)]
knitr::kable(split_counts, align = "lrr", caption = "Flight records by data split.")
```

Use `flights_cleaned.csv` for exploratory analysis and modeling. The file
contains `r count_fmt(nrow(flights))` flight records and `r ncol(flights)` columns.
For predictions made before departure, use information available at prediction
time, such as scheduled times and airport information. Actual timestamps,
observed delays, and taxi times are historical outcomes.
